corroborationSummary: Corpus search found no second dual-load wash implementation witness. W1 (Samsung WV55M9600) fit-test conclusions remain valid and unfalsified but uncorroborated. The reduced model (FL_LOWER + FL_UPPER + minimal integration domain with inter-instance communication, system supervision, and enable/inhibit facets) cannot be confirmed or broken cross-implementation until a genuine W2 manual is acquired and fit-tested. This gate documents W2 candidate inventory, falsification protocol, and W1 baseline — not corroboration success.
